title: The Hiking Club Summits
story: Fall color peaked on the long October weekend, and four members of the hiking club set off up four different hills. Wren whispered the whole way up hers, though there was nobody to disturb but a chipmunk. Back at the trailhead, the club's logbook shows four summit heights and not one name, and Felix calls that anything but shipshape. Who hiked which hill, what did each pack for a snack, and how high did each one top out?

texts: Felix topped out at neither 1,000 feet nor 1,200 feet.
The hiker on Bramble Hill did not top out at 1,200 feet.
Cass topped out lower than the hiker who packed jerky.
The hiker who packed figs is neither Felix nor Enzo.
The hiker who packed trail mix topped out exactly 200 feet higher than the hiker who packed jerky.
Of Wren and Enzo, one topped out at 1,400 feet and the other topped out at 1,200 feet.
Cass topped out exactly 400 feet lower than the hiker on Fiddler Hill.
The hiker on Crow's Nest is neither Felix nor Enzo.
The hiker who topped out at 1,400 feet is neither Enzo nor Cass.
